== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Death Star Gunner (V) (Errata 2)]] (Virtual Block 1 slip 08), showing the '''PC-E2''' game text. No published full card image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Death Star Gunner (V)]] (original, release-sheet slip) and [[Death Star Gunner (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, Players Committee card image).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The ▲ is written out there ("take a Superlaser into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle"), as drawn here.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “While on Death Star: cancels Force drain bonuses from Death Star sites' game text, your [A New Hope] Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to take a Superlaser into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1001_L6232</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>2_86</code>, title, lore, icons, set mark) with the PC-E2 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
